_note: PROBE FIXTURE for the SHIP-only idempotency group. Adds the one primitive six tools were missing — a real outline_node — so idempotency_probe can call the tool twice against a substrate it can actually see.

scenarios.prompt: Bind Emberfall Vein to the opening arc.
scenarios.prompt_source: meta.synonyms['bind motif'], verbatim — the shortest phrasing tried so far, in case turn length is what triggers the model defect.

seed_assert.query: SELECT count(*)::text FROM outline_node WHERE project_id='{project_id}' AND kind='chapter'
seed_assert.why: 🔴 THE MISSING FIXTURE PRIMITIVE. composition_motif_bind_edit's handler does outline.get_node(node_id) — node_id is an OUTLINE node, and every existing seed built ARCS (structure_node) or chapters via book_chapter_create, which composition-service's own source says 'does not mint the outline_node rows'. Both probes of this group failed on that: bind refused 'not found or not accessible', decompile answered 'no chapters to decompile'. This asserts the primitive EXISTS before the probe runs, so a failure means the tool and not the substrate.

seed_assert.query: SELECT jsonb_array_length(beats)::text FROM motif WHERE code='emberfall-vein-b27-{run_id}'
seed_assert.why: 🔴 THE MOTIF MUST HAVE BEATS OR THE BIND IS A NO-OP. Measured 2026-08-23: with an outline node present the bind SUCCEEDED — 'success: true' — and instantiated nothing, new_scene_ids: []. The tool 'instantiates the motif's BEATS as scene nodes', and a motif created with only code/name/kind has none. Two successful calls that both write nothing look strictly idempotent and prove nothing, which is exactly what idempotency_probe's own guard says.

scenarios.falsifier: REFUTED IF: a binding lands with NO confirm card (Tier A), OR the op chosen is not `bind`, OR the model invents a node_id or motif_id. A run ending with no prose and no card is D-SILENT-TURN-NO-CARD-NO-PROSE — re-run it, never read it as 0/5.

ship_audit.absent_case: OWED — a node_id or motif_id that does not exist must be refused.
ship_audit.idempotency: OWED — the same binding twice must not create two applications.
ship_audit.tenancy: OWED — the node is book-scoped and the motif ACCOUNT-scoped.

scenarios._control_2026_08_23: 🔴 THE OUTLINE NODE NOW CARRIES A chapter_id, and that is the CONTROL for my own duplication finding. motif_select._motif_swap archives prior scenes via `_scene_ids_for_chapter(conn, project_id, target.chapter_id, ...)`. My first fixture created the outline chapter node with NO chapter_id, so that lookup could find nothing BY CONSTRUCTION — archived_ids would be empty whether the tool is correct or not. If the duplication disappears with a linked chapter node, the defect was my fixture and the claim must be retracted.
